title: Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program Catalogue of Usage Types: Instrument Families, Covered Instruments and Grades
content:
The Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program loans district-owned instruments to band and orchestra students under six official usage types. Each usage type is defined by its instrument family, the district-owned instruments loaned under it, the grades it admits, the ensemble course the student must be scheduled in, and who may check out over the summer.

## Usage types and the instruments they cover

| Usage type | Instrument family | District-owned instruments loaned | Grades admitted | Ensemble course required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | percussion | bell kit, practice pad kit, snare drum | 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 | band |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | woodwind | oboe, bassoon, bass clarinet, baritone saxophone | 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 | band |
| Brass Instrument Usage | brass | French horn, mellophone, baritone horn | 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 | band |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | strings | violin, viola | 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 | orchestra |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | large instrument | tuba, euphonium, cello, string bass | 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 | band or orchestra |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | summer | oboe, bassoon, bass clarinet, baritone saxophone, French horn, mellophone, baritone horn, violin, viola, tuba, euphonium, cello, string bass | 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 | band or orchestra |

## Summer eligibility, home-and-school pairs and student-supplied items

| Usage type | Who may check out over the summer | One instrument for home and one kept at school | Items the student buys and keeps |
|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | not applicable | no | sticks, mallets |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | not applicable | no | reeds, cork grease, swab |
| Brass Instrument Usage | not applicable | no | mouthpiece, valve oil, slide grease |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | not applicable | no | rosin, shoulder rest, cleaning cloth |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | not applicable | yes | mouthpiece, rosin, valve oil |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | students enrolled in the ensemble for the next school year | no | reeds, mouthpiece, rosin |

## Reading the catalogue

- **Which usage type receives a home-and-school pair?** Only Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass): the student receives one instrument for home and one kept at school. Every other usage type loans a single instrument.
- **Is a snare drum available over the summer?** No. The Summer Instrument Checkout list carries woodwind, brass, string and large instruments only; the bell kit, practice pad kit and snare drum appear only under Percussion Equipment Usage.
- **Does a grade 5 student appear in any school-year usage type?** No. Grade 5 is admitted only under Summer Instrument Checkout, whose grades run 5 through 11; the five school-year usage types admit grades 6 through 12.
- **Are student-supplied items part of the loan?** No. The items in the last column are bought by the family and kept by the student; they are not district-owned instruments.

A hypothetical illustration of reading the tables: a student scheduled in orchestra who has been assigned a cello holds Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass), because the cello is listed only there; the same student assigned a viola would hold Orchestra String Instrument Usage.
